stats.label: Armor - Blunt
stats.description:
The protection given against blunt damage like fists, club impacts and rock falls.

Upon taking damage, first this armor rating is reduced by the attack's armor penetration value.

The remaining armor rating is then compared against a random number from 0 to 100.

    - If the random number is under half the armor rating, the damage deflects harmlessly.
    - If the random number is over half the armor rating, but not higher than the armor rating, the damage is reduced by half and changed to blunt.
    - If the random number is greater than the armor rating, the armor has no effect.

For example, at 90% armor rating against an attack with 10% armor penetration, there is a 40% chance of deflecting the attack harmlessly, and a 40% chance of mitigating the damage.

Each layer of armor is applied separately, from the outside in.

stats.label: Armor - Blunt
stats.description: Armor against blunt damage like club impacts, rock falls, and explosions.

stats.label: Armor - Heat
stats.description:
The protection given against temperature-related damage like burns.

Upon taking damage, first this armor rating is reduced by the attack's armor penetration value.

The remaining armor rating is then compared against a random number from 0 to 100.

    - If the random number is under half the armor rating, the damage deflects harmlessly.
    - If the random number is over half the armor rating, but not higher than the armor rating, the damage is reduced by half and changed to blunt.
    - If the random number is greater than the armor rating, the armor has no effect.

For example, at 90% armor rating against an attack with 10% armor penetration, there is a 40% chance of deflecting the attack harmlessly, and a 40% chance of mitigating the damage.

Each layer of armor is applied separately, from the outside in.

stats.label: Armor - Heat
stats.description: Armor against temperature-related damage like burns.

stats.label: Armor - Sharp
stats.description:
The protection given against sharp damage like bullets, knife stabs, explosions, and animal bites.

Upon taking damage, first this armor rating is reduced by the attack's armor penetration value.

The remaining armor rating is then compared against a random number from 0 to 100.

    - If the random number is under half the armor rating, the damage deflects harmlessly.
    - If the random number is over half the armor rating, but not higher than the armor rating, the damage is reduced by half and changed to blunt.
    - If the random number is greater than the armor rating, the armor has no effect.

For example, at 90% armor rating against an attack with 10% armor penetration, there is a 40% chance of deflecting the attack harmlessly, and a 40% chance of mitigating the damage.

Each layer of armor is applied separately, from the outside in.

stats.label: Armor - Sharp
stats.description: Armor against sharp damage like bullets, knife stabs, and animal bites.

stats.label: cooking speed

stats.label: crawl speed

stats.label: damage multiplier

stats.label: deep drilling speed

stats.label: drug cooking speed

stats.label: drug crop harvest yield

stats.label: drug sell price improvement

stats.label: eating speed

stats.label: EMP resistance

stats.label: equip delay

stats.label: flammability

stats.label: flight cooldown

stats.label: food poison chance

stats.label: food poison chance

stats.label: foraged food amount
stats.description: The amount of nutrition this person will automatically forage per day while traveling by caravan.

stats.label: general labor speed

stats.label: global learning factor

stats.label: global work speed

stats.label: goodwill impact

stats.label: hacking speed

stats.label: hacking stealth
stats.description: How much hacking progress can be made on average before this person is temporarily locked out of a computer system. Only certain systems are capable of detecting hacking.

stats.label: honor value

stats.label: market value
stats.description: The market value of an object.\n\nThe actual trade price will be adjusted by negotiation skill, relationship status, and other contextual factors.

stats.label: mass

stats.label: melee armor penetration

stats.label: mining speed

stats.label: Mortar miss radius multiplier

stats.label: move speed

stats.label: negotiation ability

stats.label: neural heat gain

stats.label: outdoor beauty

stats.label: plant harvest yield

stats.label: repair success chance

stats.label: research speed

stats.label: Shield max energy

stats.label: sleep fall rate

stats.label: smelting speed

stats.label: smoothing speed

stats.label: stagger time multiplier

stats.label: tame animal chance

stats.label: work to make

stats.description: Fertility affects the chance of a pregnancy occurring. Pregnancy chance is dependent on the fertility of both partners. This also affects the chance of successfully implanting an embryo in a surrogate.

stats.label: genetic complexity increase
stats.description: When placed near a gene assembler, this building increases the maximum genetic complexity that can be assembled at once.

stats.label: growth vat occupant speed
stats.description: A multiplier on how quickly this person will grow when in a growth vat.

stats.label: hemogen gain multiplier
stats.description: A multiplier on the amount of hemogen gained.

stats.label: learning rate factor
stats.description: A multiplier on how quickly a child's learning need is fulfilled by learning activities.

stats.label: max install count
stats.description: How many times this can be installed. Each additional installation increases or upgrades the base effect.

stats.label: mech bandwidth
stats.description: How much bandwidth a mechanitor has. More bandwidth allows a mechanitor to produce and control more mechs at the same time.\n\nLosing bandwidth means losing control of mechs, leaving them without an overseer. Such mechs can eventually become feral if not re-dominated.

stats.label: mech control groups
stats.description: How many control groups this mechanitor can direct independently. Each control group can be given its own separate orders.

stats.label: mech gestation speed
stats.description: A multiplier on the speed at which this mechanitor can form new mechanoids at a gestator.

stats.label: mech remote repair distance
stats.description: How far away a mech can be during remote repair.

stats.label: mech remote shield distance
stats.description: The maximum range at which a mechanitor can place a shield on a mechanoid.

stats.label: mech remote shield energy
stats.description: The energy a remote shield will have when created by a mechanitor.

stats.label: mech repair speed
stats.description: A multiplier on how fast a mechanitor can repair mechanoids.

stats.label: mech work speed offset
stats.description: A work speed offset applied to a mechanitor's mechs.

stats.label: melee door damage factor
stats.description: A special multiplier on the amount of melee damage inflicted on doors.

stats.label: raw nutrition multiplier
stats.description: A multiplier on how nutritious raw food is for this person. Note that since meals usually have more nutrition than their raw ingredients, a boost to this stat may only mean the person gets the same nutrition from raw food as if it were cooked.

stats.label: repair energy cost
stats.description: The amount of energy that this mechanoid loses for every 100 damage repaired.

stats.label: subcore encoding speed
stats.description: A multiplier on how fast a mechanitor can create subcores.

stats.label: wastepacks per recharge
stats.description: How many toxic wastepacks this mechanoid will generate at a mech recharger when going from 0 to 100% energy. Larger mechanoids will generally create more toxic wastepacks.

stats.label: work speed factor
stats.description: The speed at which people assemble genes here is multiplied by this value.

stats.label: activity suppression speed
stats.description: The speed at which this person can suppress unnatural entities. A higher speed means they take less time to suppress each entity.

stats.label: cold containment bonus
stats.description: This entity is less likely to escape if kept in a very cold room.

stats.label: containment strength
stats.description: How securely this can contain an entity. This is improved by stronger walls and doors, more light, fewer other entities in the room, and special containment devices. Some entities are easier to contain in cold temperatures.

stats.label: entity study rate
stats.description: The rate at which this person generates knowledge from studying unnatural entities.

stats.label: min containment strength
stats.description: The containment strength needed to contain this entity properly. An entity in a chamber below its minimum containment strength will have a very high chance to escape.

stats.label: psychic ritual quality
stats.description: How much nearby buildings improve quality of psychic rituals performed here.

stats.label: psychic ritual quality offset
stats.description: An offset applied to psychic ritual quality when this person participates. The total quality offset is divided by the total number of participants.

stats.label: study efficiency
stats.description: A multiplier on how much knowledge a person gets when studying unnatural entities.

stats.label: fishing speed
stats.description: The speed at which this person catches fish.

stats.label: fishing yield
stats.description: The percentage yield this person receives when they fish.

stats.label: gravship range
stats.description: The maximum distance this gravship can travel with its connected substructure.

stats.label: piloting ability
stats.description: How well this person can pilot a vehicle.

stats.label: substructure support
stats.description: The maximum amount of substructure supported by this gravship.

stats.label: vacuum resistance
stats.description: How resistant this creature is to the negative effects of the vacuum of space.
